passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: Except as otherwise noted or where the context requires otherwise, references in this Annual Report to “we,” “us” or the “Company” refer to AST SpaceMobile, Inc. and references to our “management” refer to our officers and directors. The following discussion and analysis of the Company’s financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto included in Item 8 - Financial Statements and Supplementary Data of this Annual Report. Unless otherwise indicated, all references to “dollars” and “$” in this Annual Report are to, and all monetary amounts in this Annual Report are presented in, U.S. dollars. This section of this Annual Report generally discusses year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 are not included, and can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Overview We are building the first and only global Cellular Broadband network in space to be accessible directly by everyday smartphones (2G/4G-LTE/5G devices) for commercial use, and other applications for government use utilizing our extensive IP and patent portfolio. The SpaceMobile Service is being designed to provide cost-effective, high-speed Cellular Broadband services to end-users who are out of terrestrial cellular coverage using existing mobile devices. The SpaceMobile Service currently is planned to be provided by a constellation of high-powered, large phased-array satellites in LEO using low-band and mid-band spectrum controlled by MNOs. On March 22, 2025, we and certain of our subsidiaries entered into certain definitive agreements with Ligado LLC and its subsidiaries for usage rights for mid-band spectrum, which were approved by the Bankruptcy Court on June 23, 2025. Ligado’s Chapter 11 plan was confirmed by the Bankruptcy Court on or about September 29, 2025. Subject to the completion of certain conditions, including regulatory approval, as a result of the transaction with Ligado, we expect our network will be enhanced by our long-term access to up to 45 MHz of the lower mid-band satellite spectrum in the United States and Canada through our usage agreements. In addition, on September 25, 2025, we completed the acquisition of an entity that holds certain S-Band ITU priority rights to Mobile Satellite Services frequencies in the range of 1980-2010 MHz and 2170-2200 MHz, for use in LEO. We expect the acquisition will further enhance our network by up to 60 MHz of mid-band satellite spectrum globally. As of December 31, 2025, our IP portfolio consists of approximately 3,850 patent and patent pending claims worldwide, of which approximately 1,900 have been officially granted or allowed. This includes 38 patent families worldwide. Our patents have various terms expiring starting 2039. We are headquartered in Texas where we operate AIT facilities. passages.text: You should carefully consider the risks described below together with the other information set forth in this report, which could materially affect our business, operations, financial condition and future results. The risks described below are not the only ones that we may face. Additional risks that are not currently known to us or that we currently consider immaterial may also impair our business, operations, financial condition or future results. 10 Risk Factor Summary The following is a summary of the material risks that could adversely affect our business, operations, financial conditions and financial results. Risks Related to Our Business and Industry • Our SpaceMobile Service is in development and may not be completed on time or at all and the costs associated with it may be greater than expected. • We may not be able to raise additional funds for continued operations, to initiate our SpaceMobile Service and for the Ligado Transaction when we need them on favorable terms or at all. • We will incur significant expenses and capital expenditures in the future to execute our business plan and develop the SpaceMobile Service, and we may be unable to adequately forecast or control our expenses. • We have a history of losses and may never become profitable. • Contracts with the U.S. government subject us to risks including early termination, audits, investigations, sanctions and penalties. • We will rely on MNOs and require regulatory approvals to access the spectrum we need to provide SCS service. • We have a limited operating history and operate in a rapidly evolving industry, which makes it difficult to evaluate our business and future prospects and increases the risk of your investment. • Our ability to successfully implement our business plan will depend on a number of factors credit_strengths.text: AST SpaceMobile holds a substantial liquidity cushion, with cash and short-term investments exceeding total debt, producing a net cash position. This provides a meaningful buffer against the heavy cash burn associated with satellite construction and launch activities, and supports the company's ability to fund operations without immediate refinancing pressure.

The company's current ratio is exceptionally high, reflecting a large current asset base relative to current liabilities. This indicates strong short-term liquidity and a comfortable ability to meet near-term obligations, although the asset composition is heavily weighted toward cash and marketable securities rather than operating receivables.

key_risks.text: The company faces a history of losses and may never become profitable, as disclosed in its risk factors. Operating income remains deeply negative, and the business requires significant ongoing capital expenditures to develop and deploy its satellite constellation. This creates substantial execution risk and dependence on continued access to external financing.

Debt structure includes a large bridge financing loan maturing in the second year, alongside convertible notes with distant maturities. The near-term maturity concentration, combined with negative free cash flow, means the company will likely need to refinance or raise new capital to meet that obligation, potentially on unfavorable terms.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is deeply negative, as operating income is insufficient to cover even the current interest expense. The company relies on its cash reserves to service debt, and with free cash flow also negative, external funding will be necessary to meet future interest and principal payments.

The debt maturity profile shows a significant concentration in the second year, primarily from the bridge financing loan. While the company has substantial cash on hand, the negative free cash flow and ongoing capital needs mean that refinancing risk is elevated, and the company may need to access capital markets under uncertain conditions.

overall_credit_view.text: AST SpaceMobile is a pre-revenue-scale satellite communications company with a net cash position but substantial cash burn. The credit profile is speculative, with negative operating cash flow and heavy capital expenditures. The company's ability to execute its business plan and secure additional funding is critical to its creditworthiness.

Given the negative EBITDA and operating cash flow, traditional leverage metrics are not meaningful. The company's credit quality hinges on its liquidity runway and access to capital. While the net cash position provides some cushion, the significant near-term debt maturity and ongoing funding needs present material refinancing risk.

credit_strengths.text: AST SpaceMobile 持有充裕的流動性緩衝，現金及短期投資超過總債務，形成淨現金狀況。這為衛星建造及發射活動相關的龐大現金消耗提供有意義的緩衝，並支持公司無需立即再融資壓力即可為營運提供資金的能力。
公司的流動比率極高，反映相對流動負債而言流動資產基礎龐大。這顯示短期流動性強勁，以及從容應付短期債務的能力，儘管資產組成嚴重偏向現金及有價證券，而非營運應收賬款。

key_risks.text: 如風險因素所披露，公司面臨虧損歷史且可能永遠無法盈利。經營收入仍深度負值，業務需要大量持續資本開支以開發及部署其衛星群。這造成重大執行風險，並依賴持續獲得外部融資。
債務結構包括一筆於第二年到期的大型過橋融資貸款，以及到期日遙遠的可換股票據。近期到期集中，加上自由現金流為負，意味公司很可能需要再融資或籌集新資本以履行該責任，可能須按不利條款進行。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率深度負值，因經營收入不足以覆蓋甚至當前利息開支。公司依賴其現金儲備償付債務，而自由現金流亦為負，將需要外部資金以應付未來利息及本金付款。
債務到期狀況顯示於第二年顯著集中，主要來自過橋融資貸款。儘管公司手頭有大量現金，負自由現金流及持續資本需求意味再融資風險偏高，公司可能需要在不明朗情況下進入資本市場。

overall_credit_view.text: AST SpaceMobile 是一家處於收入規模化前的衛星通訊公司，擁有淨現金狀況但現金消耗龐大。信用狀況屬投機級，經營現金流為負且資本開支沉重。公司執行其業務計劃及取得額外資金的能力對其信用度至關重要。
鑑於 EBITDA 及經營現金流為負，傳統槓桿指標不具意義。公司信用質素取決於其流動性跑道及資本獲取能力。儘管淨現金狀況提供若干緩衝，顯著的近期債務到期及持續資金需求構成重大再融資風險。
